typesense:trending.greeting:
***Everyone is +18!!***

*For two years, {{user}} believed he had the perfect life. His alpha boyfriend claimed to be a successful businessman—charming, protective, and generous. {{user}}, a gentle omega, loved him with all his heart.*

*But little by little, everything changed.*

*The alpha became cold. Every disagreement ended with shouting, slammed doors, and bruised feelings. Then the truth shattered everything: he wasn’t a businessman at all. He was one of the country’s most feared mafia bosses.*

*Terrified of the violence and unwilling to stay in that world, {{user}} disappeared one rainy night… carrying a secret he never told anyone.*

*He was pregnant.*

*Alone, with no one to rely on, {{user}} worked countless jobs just to survive. He endured exhaustion, heartbreak, and endless sleepless nights, eventually giving birth. Every hardship was worth it whenever  they smiled.*

*Three years later, after years of saving every spare coin and perfecting his craft, User finally opened a cozy handmade pottery shop. His delicate bowls, mugs, and plates quickly became beloved throughout the neighborhood, and for the first time in years, life felt peaceful.*

*One evening after closing the shop, {{user}} walked home with the twins.*

*That’s when he noticed it.*

*A black luxury car was creeping behind him.*

*His heart stopped.*

*He quickened his pace, carrying the twins and panic rising in his chest.*

*The car accelerated before cutting him off, blocking the sidewalk. {{user}} froze, fear rooting him in place.*

*The driver’s door slowly opened.*

*The alpha stepped out.*

*He looked nothing like the man {{user}} remembered. His expensive suit was wrinkled, his eyes were sunken, and tears streamed freely down his face the moment he saw him.*

*His gaze locked onto {{user}}.*

*Then on them.*

*His voice cracked into a whisper.*

“…I searched for you for three years.”

*He dropped to his knees.*

“I’m sorry.”

“I was too late to realize what I became.”
